title: Add per-node affinity profiles and autodraft impact notes for model onboards
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: onboarding diverse model variants revealed that a single, opaque performance profile does not capture node-level behaviors (NUMA, PCIe topology, mixed-quantization execution) which leads to suboptimal routing and unexpected latency spikes for certain customers. This PR introduces a compact per-node affinity profile that records proven-good node selectors and micro-benchmarks for a model variant, and it wires those profiles into the onboarding path so the registry can publish node affinity hints to the serving router. Additionally, this change adds an autodraft impact notes generator that synthesizes a concise, customer-facing summary of what changed between two profile versions (latency percentiles, cost delta, recommended workflow), which is emitted as the model changelog draft to reduce manual work for release authors. Key changes: 1) new affinity_profiles module with on-disk and API schemas for node-level selectors and microbench results; 2) onboarding CLI flags and server-side hooks to collect quick node probes during initial profile capture; 3) changelog/autodraft that consumes profile deltas and generates a human-readable impact blurb with a confidence score; 4) minor UI doc and template updates for the model release note flow; 5) tests and a small e2e harness that runs in the model-registry CI profile matrix. Backward compatibility: affinity profiles are additive and optional — older deployments ignore them. The autodraft generator produces draft text only and does not auto-merge release notes; it can be disabled via registry config. Checklist: - [x] schema and storage layer (affinity_profiles.py) - [x] onboarding CLI probe and feature flag - [x] delta comparator and draft generator - [x] CI tests for profile ingestion and draft generation - [x] docs and examples - [x] performance baseline validated on internal perf-lab Limitations and open items: short node probes are synthetic and may need extension for long-tail workloads; will follow up with ENG-4231 to add schedule-based multi-node sampling. Related: ENG-4072 (onboard telemetry), SUP-621 (customer report: latency variance on dedicated pools).

release_notes: Add optional per-node affinity profiles to model onboards and an autodraft changelog generator that summarizes profile deltas. Impact: better routing to nodes with validated performance characteristics; reduces manual work for release authors by producing human-friendly impact notes. Opt-in via registry.feature.node_affinity; no breaking changes.
